pages.title: Home | Sherfield School | A Day and Boarding School for boys and girls in Hook, Hampshire
blocks: We believe education should feel personal, purposeful and full of possibility. At Sherfield children flourish, characters are shaped, and futures feel expansive.

You can start your Sherfield journey at any age, from 3 months to 18 years. We are a school built on human connection. Where relationships matter, curiosity is encouraged and pupils are supported to flourish both academically and personally. From the moment your child steps through our doors, they’ll feel right at home in a community full of limitless opportunities. We believe belonging fuels achievement. Whether boarding or attending as a day pupil, Sherfield is the perfect place for your child to build their future while feeling deeply rooted.
Educating for Life, Ready for the Future
Our community is built on the values of Respect, Courage and Kindness . We celebrate every voice, champion individuality and nurture a culture where pupils feel confident to contribute and grow.
These values guide everything we do. We empower students to make principled choices, act with empathy and develop the character and resilience needed to thrive in a changing world.
Our vision is simple and powerful: our students create a positive impact, inspiring change and a better future . We believe every young person has the potential to shape their world for the better.

Guided by our motto, “ad vitam paramus”, we prepare for life , we create a learning environment that nurtures, inspires and challenges. At Sherfield, pupils discover their strengths, develop a global outlook and leave ready to succeed with confidence and purpose.
Sherfield School’s popular and stimulating early years centre is open to children from the age of three months.
Space to Think. Room to Grow
Take a tour of our facilities, vast open landscapes and dedicated sports and arts areas, Sherfield is for work and play.
Sherfield School welcomes applications from international students
Our school is a community for all pupils.
We provide a warm, welcoming environment where every pupil feels supported and part of our close-knit community, no matter how far from home.

Archer's Lodge, our purpose-built boarding house for Year 5 and up, offers 60 hotel-style en-suite rooms, including internet access, study areas, cosy beds, and spacious bathrooms. Each floor also features generous common rooms with living, dining, and kitchen facilities, plus comfortable seating, digital TV, board games, and books, providing all the comforts of home.
We offer rolling admissions and welcome applications from parents throughout the school year for children from 3 months to 18 years old.
